slice: MutationObserver NS-attribute records + no-mutation semantics + classList record parity
context: R45 follow-up: the remaining 8F of MutationObserver-attributes split into three clusters (NS records / no-mutation guards / classList same-value records). All three fixed this round; the case reaches 100%.

fixes.ns_records: setAttributeNS/removeAttributeNS now carry their own MutationObserver notify: record.attributeName = localName (prefixed qualified names decomposed), record.attributeNamespace = ns. The old delegation to setAttribute/removeAttribute produced records with the qualified name ('xml:lang') and namespace null. The NS paths write host callbacks directly (bypassing the delegate's namespace-less notify — the first cut double-notified, caught and fixed in-round).
fixes.no_mutation_guard: removeAttribute (and removeAttributeNS) on a missing attribute no longer queue a record — spec queues a mutation record only when an existing attribute is removed (WPT 'removal no mutation': n71 without class, removeAttribute('class') then id rename → exactly 1 record). Presence checked via the same hasAttribute sources (handle/sel latest-wins).
fixes.classlist_records: DOMTokenList update step 8: serializing the new token set equal to the current attribute value still sets the attribute and queues a record (real browsers emit an attributes record for classList.add of an existing token — WPT 'classList.add: same value mutation' expects 2 records). R16's same-value early-return swallowed it. Exception: remove-to-empty-set with the attribute originally absent does NOT write or notify (remove must not create an empty class attribute — WPT checkRemove(null,...) expects attribute to stay null; caught as a -10 regression on Element-classlist.html and fixed with the _readClassRaw absence check).

results.element_classlist: 1420P/0F maintained (the classList record change regressed it to 1410 mid-round; absence-check exception restored 100%)

remaining_mo_clusters: childList: fragment addition record expansion (addedNodes should be fragment children) + insertNode/surroundContents geometry records.

unit_tests.r46_unit_test: test_mutation_observer_ns_and_no_mutation_r46 (NS records localName+namespace incl. prefixed decomposition / no-record for missing removals and empty-set remove / record for same-value add)
